programs.title: The Tunnel (Part 2)

programs.title: Unfaithful
programs.desc: A man (Richard Gere) becomes increasingly distraught after he discovers his wife (Diane Lane) is having an affair with a Frenchman (Olivier Martinez).

programs.title: The Orator

programs.title: The Man Who Knew Too Little
programs.desc: Wallace  thinks the intrigue erupting around him is part of an audience-participation theatre event. Yet the world's fate depends on this gullible dummy who can't even spell CIA.

programs.title: Monsieur Verdoux

programs.title: Bastille Day
programs.desc: When a reckless CIA agent and a brilliant pickpocket uncover a large-scale conspiracy, they must work together in order to take down a common enemy.

programs.title: Nobody Has To Know
programs.desc: A middle-aged farmhand on a remote Scottish island suffers amnesia following a stroke. A lonely local woman helps him acclimate back to his life.

programs.title: A Room With A View
programs.desc: Lucy Honeychurch shares a brief romance with George Emerson in Florence. Yet as she tries to move on with her life and look for marriage elsewhere, can she truly forget the events of that summer?

programs.title: Master Cheng (A Spice For Life)

programs.title: Angel and the Badman
programs.desc: An injured gunslinger is nursed back to health by a Quaker. When his violent past comes back to haunt him, he has to choose between her way of life and his own.

programs.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programs.desc: After a disastrous parachute drop, Rambo is left stranded in the jungles with only his combat knife and bow and arrows to protect him.
